sports.title: Neeraj Yadav death: Friend says she met him hours before he was found beside SUV
sports.body: During inquiry, a woman who had brought Yadav to the hospital told police she had been friends with him since Dec 2025. According to her statement, she went to Sonipat on Oct 27 to meet Yadav and tell him she could no longer remain in touch with him. She told police Yadav later dropped her off at Maujpur in his SUV. Around 9pm, when the woman returned to the area near Gate No. 1 of Maujpur metro station to check on him, she found him lying on the road beside his vehicle and rushed him to hospital.

sports.body: The Jr. NBA has shifted its focus from under-14s to under-16s, but developing India’s next generation of basketball talent will require more than competition. NBA India Country Head Sunny Malik discusses lessons young players learnt against Korean teams in Singapore, the need for better coaching, physical conditioning and year-round participation. He also reflects on growing girls’ participation, the role of school programmes and the potential of a proposed Indian basketball league.
